shellCommands.command:
/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | sort | rg '(forbidden|unauthorized|auth|errors)' | sed -n '1,200p'

sed -n '1,240p' package.json

sed -n '1,260p' app/lib/auth.ts

sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx

sed -n '1,220p' app/page.tsx

sed -n '1,200p' AGENTS.md"

/bin/bash -lc "find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.next/*' | sort

if [ -f tsconfig.json ]; then cat tsconfig.json; fi
if [ -f next.config.ts ]; then cat next.config.ts; fi
if [ -f next.config.js ]; then cat next.config.js; fi
if [ -f next.config.mjs ]; then cat next.config.mjs; fi

git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/admin-headers.txt -o /tmp/admin-body.html http://127.0.0.1:3000/admin && sed -n '1,20p' /tmp/admin-headers.txt && rg -o '403 · Forbidden|This area is for admins|does not have permission' /tmp/admin-body.html | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- next.config.ts app/admin/page.tsx app/admin/forbidden.tsx app/admin/admin.module.css tsconfig.json

git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat -- .gitignore next.config.ts app/admin'

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --numstat -- tsconfig.json && git diff --raw -- tsconfig.json && git status --porcelain=v2 -- tsconfig.json && git hash-object tsconfig.json && git rev-parse HEAD:tsconfig.json'
